title: Faiso's drumming and his rigging
summary: He idolized the drummer Faiso, whom he describes as loud, rough and complete, and recalls the pedal and cymbal rig.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Yeah, before they go in, well, Copperhead Hall didn't have a porch. They used to play right in front of the hall. Yeah, the band would play two or three numbers before they go inside. And, well, we all, all the kids and everybody would gang around and listen at them. Well, it was always my ambition to play drum. I love the drums. I'd look at the guys. Well, when I'd get ready to go upstairs to play, I'd grab probably the snare drum or something. I want to bring his drum upstairs for him. And after I get up there, well, I'd just stay up on the stand a while listening to them. I said, no, many times I sat down and went to sleep. They'd wake me up and run me out of that. Many times I got a whipping for coming out. The old man whipped me for staying out late at night like that. Now, who would be playing in the cooperatives hall? Well, several times I listened to Chris Kelly's band, Kid Rene band. It's one particular drummer I used to like, used to love his style of playing. And I never didn't know his right name. All I knew him was about Faisal. He always loved him. And he knew that I liked it. So he wouldn't let nobody handle his drum with me when he'd get ready to go upstairs or go in the hard way. What did he bring him in for him? What did he feature Faisal? Was he loud or soft? Did he have a lot of variation in his dynamics? I think he was a loud type of drummer, but then he was a rough drummer too at that.
He's rough. Yeah, he's pretty rough. And what would he play him? Was he a guy on the snare all the time or would he play all over the set?

All over. All over, man. He's a guy all over. He's had a nice foot on bass drum. Played that snare drum pretty nice too. He really was good. I admire him a lot. What kind of set did he have? Do you remember what his... Well, what his... I don't think I can even tell you about it now because I don't even see no more of them like that. Yeah. But I mean did he... Yeah, there's some of those overhead cymbals like they used to have. That rod holding cymbals on. He had a... this pedal... it hooks to the bottom and a rod comes all the way up. He had a spring on the top of the bass drum that pulls that rod back to... Yeah. Pull the beanie back.

Yeah, they used to get a lot out of that thing. And I don't... and I still can't understand how they did it today since they got these new foot pedals out. Yeah. I don't understand how he used to get so much out of it.
Well, what other traps did he have? I don't know.
